source.name: Community Berger 7 mm 195 Grain EOL Elite Hunter

loads.notes: Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; Twist 1:8. No powder, charge, or barrel length. One line of a four-rifle list. The .280AI 175 Elite, 7RM 180 Hybrid, and 7SS 184 Hybrid in that list are different bullets and are not rows.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Alex Wheeler; Posted: date not shown; Velocity_fps: about 3050; OAL about 3.765. Seated .015 off the lands. Typical load for the 26 in builds, not one rifle's chrono string. On the loads thread he also wrote that 85 grains of rl33 gives mid 3000s in a 26 in barrel.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; A friend's rifle built by MOA. Benchmark carbon, 8 twist. No grain charge. The author did the load work.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: effendude; Posted: date not shown; Start of the pre-ladder. He went up in half-grain steps. Steps between 83 and the named charges were not printed.
Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: effendude; Posted: date not shown; Hunted at 86 gr in Sonora. No velocity posted for that charge.
Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: effendude; Posted: date not shown; Faint ejector marks. No velocity posted.
Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: effendude; Posted: date not shown; Noticeable ejector marks. No velocity posted.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: effendude; Posted: date not shown; Scott. Very near the top for his 26 in Bartlein gain-twist barrel. On the powder thread he also wrote velocities around 3150 to 3200 fps in the 86-88 grain range.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; Charge_gr: 85-86; Velocity_fps: around 3050; 300 yard ladder. The node is the 85-86 gr span, so the steps were not printed. He hit pressure around 88 gr with a throat set up for 180 hybrids. That 88 gr note is not a 195 velocity, so it is not its own row.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: RustyB; Posted: date not shown; Velocity_fps: right at 3000; Page fetch did not repeat the author header. This is the thread starter reporting a load for his rifle. Group less than half an inch. Not pushing it.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Switchbarrel; Posted: date not shown; Velocity_fps: ~3050; About 20 thousandths jump. 30 in Krieger. One of eight rounds fired for velocity and a 100 yard sight-in.
Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Switchbarrel; Posted: date not shown; Five-shot average. About 20 thousandths jump. 30 in Krieger.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Switchbarrel; Posted: date not shown; As he recalled, and the only shot at this charge. About 20 thousandths jump. 30 in Krieger.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Switchbarrel; Posted: date not shown; Velocity_fps: 3220-something; Only round fired at this charge. About 20 thousandths jump. 30 in Krieger.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; 195s touching the lands. Single-digit ES and SD. Fed 210M and CCI Magnum primers gave the same result. Cartridge is the thread's 28 Nosler.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: RustyB; Posted: Oct 25, 2016; Break-in. Bartlein 1:8. 195s .015 off the lands, boat tail just above the shoulder-neck junction. Pressure signs started at 70 gr, a separate row.
Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: RustyB; Posted: Oct 25, 2016; Pressure signs during break-in. No velocity posted for 70 gr.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; Test load for roughly 70 of the 28 Noslers he built. Long throat for the 195. Accuracy in the .2s. He said to drop a few grains after the barrel speeds up. A customer went from 3143 fps to 3210 fps on a 195 and then backed off 2 grains. That charge was not stated, so those two speeds are not stored.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Alex Wheeler; Posted: date not shown; Velocity_fps: about 3050; Same typical-build note as the 85 gr of 33. Seated .015 off, OAL about 3.765. He also wrote on the loads thread that retumbo should be about 80 grains.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Alex Wheeler; Posted: date not shown; Charge_gr: 88-89; Velocity_fps: almost 3200; High node on those 26 in builds. Charge is the span he named, not printed steps. Powder is rl33 from the same sentence as the 85 gr load.
Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Alex Wheeler; Posted: Jan 15, 2025; Velocity_fps: 3100 to 3200; When the 28 Nosler came out. No charge.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; Bob Beck Badrock. The builder reported 2886 fps and the shooter gets 2861 fps at sea level. Those are two speeds of one unstated charge, so velocity is left empty. The charge was described as nowhere near 80 grains, so 80 is not stored. 24 in #4 barrel, 8 twist.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; CA Ridgeline, .020 off the lands. He called it the hardest load he has built up. Cartridge is the thread.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: SouthPaw; Posted: date not shown; Velocity_fps: just shy of 2800; 24 in Proof, 1:8.4. COAL is a .025 jump. Never hit pressure. Best groups at this speed. Cartridge is the thread. The 180 ELD-M at about 2875 fps in the same post is a different bullet and is not a row.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: tdbaugha; Posted: date not shown; Velocity_fps: 2690-2710; Page fetch did not repeat the author header. The 20 in 8-twist barrel and 3.170 COAL match the thread starter's rifle. Safe speeds from a velocity ladder. He picked N560 from a Berger reply. The Berger table was not copied. Pronounced ejector marks were at the higher speed, a separate row.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: tdbaugha; Posted: date not shown; Pushed to this speed and saw pronounced ejector marks. Charge not stated. Same 20 in 8-twist rifle and 3.170 COAL.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; 24 in Bartlein, 8.5 twist. Average speed, SD 3.8, ES 9.0. He corrected the freebore note to a 0.015 jump. No grain charge. Quarter MOA.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: not shown in the page fetch; Posted: date not shown; 26 in, 9 twist. No grain charge. He could not get good velocity with H1000 in the SAUM case. A reply from lager gave COAL 3.150 in his chamber. That figure is not stored as this row's COAL because the velocity sentence had no author header.

Decimals as printed. The H1000 168 LRX at about 3100 fps in the same post is a different bullet and is not a row.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: 30338; Posted: Dec 2, 2015; Son's 9-twist rifle in the same article. Chambering not restated. Only 3-shot group, .48 in, at the lands. No velocity posted.
Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: 30338; Posted: Dec 2, 2015; Best accuracy in his rifle. Sub MOA from the lands out to .06 off. 8.5 twist Rock, 25 in.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: 30338; Posted: Dec 2, 2015; 8.5 twist Rock. Lands at 3.56, settled .015 off. No outward pressure signs. He worked 66 to 70 gr and the velocity across that span ran from just under 2800 fps to this 2900 fps high. Intermediate steps were not printed.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Pudgy; Posted: Aug 23, 2022; Five-shot average, SD 7, ES 15, group .445. Twice-fired brass the next morning averaged 3045 fps, ES 10, SD 20. He did not restate the charge for that string. 24 in Proof Elevation MTR. Virgin ADG, later the twice-fired note. Federal 215. BTO 2.8200, jump .015 off. Long freebore. MagnetoSpeed. Way over the VV book max he quoted. The book row was not copied. He started at 62 gr and only posted the charges named here.
